timing_roles.energy: C*V^2 per complete 0->1->0 cycle, one supply-charge event; read/write charge every nonclock lead one such cycle. Clock lead is separate, added once in read/write_plus_clock_access_energy. Full boundary clock driver also includes original clk pin capacitance; CTS is outside scope.

ff_min_hold.policy: No MAX lead or positive slew/load delay added to minimum CQ

timing_roles.leakage: Conservative existing compiler area-proportional density applied to full new outline, including passive access. Unchanged original core-source leakage is separately reported; no leakage benefit claimed.
timing_roles.reason: Current single-library-per-corner writer/readers do not bind separate MIN and MAX CQ roles

physical.column_interleave: data bit b, column select s -> physical column b*mux + s
